firstPlayerRule: The youngest player is the first judge.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The judge draws a card and reads one question aloud. The other players write their answers; the youngest-player rule assigns the judge, not the first answerer.
